hypotheses.R0_central_difference_validates_autodiff: At least one central-difference scale has tensor-metric relative error at most 0.01.
hypotheses.R1_sensitivity16_is_mostly_context_span: Mean squared canonical overlap between metric-sensitivity-16 and the frozen context span is at least 0.75.
hypotheses.R2_context_span_is_small_edit_causally_s: Context-16 tensor-effect fidelity is at least 0.75 at 0.1x on every corpus and both position groups.
hypotheses.R3_context_span_nearly_matches_sensitivi: Metric-sensitivity-16 exceeds context-16 by at most 0.10 at 0.1x on every corpus and both position groups.
hypotheses.R4_native64_is_not_a_substitute_for_dens: Metric-sensitivity-16 exceeds top-native-64 by at least 0.20 at 0.1x on every corpus at held-out positions.
hypotheses.R5_sensitivity16_beats_random_dense16: Metric-sensitivity-16 exceeds random-dense-16 by at least 0.50 at 0.1x on every corpus and both position groups.
hypotheses.R6_sensitivity16_beats_predictive16: Metric-sensitivity-16 exceeds predictive-16 by at least 0.20 at 0.1x on every corpus and both position groups.
hypotheses.R7_sensitivity16_transfers_to_unseen_pos: For each corpus, metric-sensitivity-16 differs by at most 0.15 between discovery and held-out positions at 0.1x.
hypotheses.R8_sensitivity16_remains_full_edit_suffi: Metric-sensitivity-16 tensor-effect fidelity is at least 0.85 at 1.0x on every corpus and both position groups.
hypotheses.R9_each_metric_finds_a_compact_causal_ba: Metric-sensitivity-16 reaches 0.75 in tensor fidelity and Euclidean-sensitivity-16 reaches 0.75 in coefficient fidelity at 0.1x everywhere.
hypotheses.R10_metric_choice_does_not_radically_rot: Mean squared canonical overlap between metric- and Euclidean-sensitivity-16 is at least 0.50.
hypotheses.R11_native128_remains_incomplete: Top-native-128 tensor-effect fidelity is below 0.70 at 0.1x on every corpus at held-out positions.
